Messages.Author: Ben Peal
Messages.Body:
This came up in Tortured Confession: Boston:

Can Marciana Giovanni be tapped for her special ability while
in torpor?

I ruled "yes", as there was nothing in the card text that stated
she must be ready.

- Ben Peal, Prince of Boston
fu...@mindstorm.com

> Correct.

Interesting. So, theoretically, if a vampire had a tap ability that
gave +1 stealth to another minion's action, would that be usable by
that vampire in torpor, or would that be considered an action modifier
and fall under the same rule as Cloak?

- Jason Bell

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Special abilities don't care about torpor unless they say so. Marcianna's
special doesn't make any reference about her being "ready".

Some theoretical vampire could be designed to do the same with stealth,
or it could be designed to be usable when ready.

Special abilities are not action modifiers.


